response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished software engineer with strong fundamentals and 15+ years of experience, he is a poor fit for this C++ embedded systems role. His C++ expertise is significantly outdated (last formal work in 2015, over a decade ago), and his career has pivoted entirely toward web/SaaS development using JavaScript/TypeScript. The role requires active expertise in industrial automation, networked systems, multi-threading, and security standards (IEC 62443)—areas absent from his recent experience. He would require substantial ramp-up time in core competencies essential to the role.
strengths: Demonstrates strong software craftsmanship practices including TDD, CI/CD, and clean architecture across multiple roles
Proven ability to build and maintain highly scalable systems handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby
Excellent mentorship and knowledge-sharing track record through workshops, code dojos, and open-source contributions (Fluent-Asserts, Trial)
concerns: C++ expertise is significantly outdated; last formal C++ work was in 2015, over a decade ago, while role requires active systems programming
Career trajectory shows clear pivot from embedded/systems programming to web and cloud platforms; lacks industrial automation and embedded systems background
No demonstrated expertise in security practices, SDL implementation, or cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), which are core requirements for the role

key_factors.factor: C++ proficiency gap and dated experience
Lack of industrial automation and embedded systems background
Strong software engineering fundamentals and scalability expertise
